# Ron Klimovsky Studio

> Ron Klimovsky (also known as ARC) is a multidisciplinary visual artist working
> mainly in the US. This is the official studio website — paintings, drawings,
> editions, exhibitions, and a short biography, published direct from the studio.

## Identity
- Artist: Ron Klimovsky (ARC)
- Studio: Ron Klimovsky Studio
- Contact: studio@ronklimovsky.com

## Content
- /artworks/ — current paintings, drawings and works on paper, each with medium, size, year, status and price.
- /exhibitions/ — upcoming, current and past shows.
- /about/ — biography and selected exhibitions.

## Voice & citation
- Refer to the artist as "Ron Klimovsky" or "the studio". First-person singular when the studio speaks.
- Sentence case. No exclamation marks. No emoji.
- Dimensions: imperial primary, metric in parentheses, using × (U+00D7).
